mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} ORDER BY sort_order ASC;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_key, config_value, config_group, config_type, description, is_encrypted, is_system, sort_order) VALUES (#{sysConfig.configKey}, #{sysConfig.configValue}, #{sysConfig.configGroup}, #{sysConfig.configType}, #{sysConfig.description}, #{sysConfig.isEncrypted}, #{sysConfig.isSystem}, #{sysConfig.sortOrder});
